AVIARY

// AVIATION MAINTENANCE TRACKER

A multi-user maintenance and flight-hours tracker for general-aviation aircraft owners. It tracks recurring service items on calendar or engine-hours cycles with live "time left" and one-click roll-forward, logs flights by hand or by importing Garmin avionics CSVs, and keeps Hobbs/Tach meters in sync. Every account is fully isolated, with ownership enforced server-side on every write.

DEADHEAD

// CHARTER TRIP OPTIMIZER

A trip planner for pilots flying client charters. Import a week's calendar and Deadhead weighs every choice after each leg — fly the plane home, leave it and Uber back, or overnight at a hotel — then returns the cheapest plan for the week next to the "always fly home" habit. Titles with airport codes are read for free; plain-English events go to Claude on the pilot's own encrypted API key.

RAPIDAID

// DISASTER-RELIEF MATCHING

A disaster-relief web app that connects people who need help with responders who can provide it. After a quick email sign-up, anyone can post an aid request with a location and a free-text need, and Google Gemini tags it as Food, Water, Shelter, Medical, or Other. Responders work a shared dashboard to filter, claim, and complete requests through an unclaimed → claimed → completed workflow, with one-tap Google Maps directions.
